brand.name: Zoho CRM
brand.summary: Zoho CRM is an AI-powered sales platform providing end-to-end sales force automation, customer engagement, and forecasting tools. Serving over 350,000 businesses globally, it enables cross-team collaboration with dedicated Teamspaces and Zia AI agents. The platform offers low-code customization, 1,000+ app integrations, and rapid professional implementation through its Jumpstart program.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: An agentic, AI-driven CRM platform focused on scalable sales operations, custom modular views, automation, and data privacy without binding contracts.
